title: Add the record button and select mode

session.words: Reading of the ask: (1) set up a workspace with a git repo for this project's work. No repos are attached yet; check list_repos for a suitable one (e.g. agent_os/agents_os). If none exists, init a local git repo in the workspace and ask Andrei to create a GitHub repo so you can attach and push. (2) Publish an HTML artifact that's otherwise empty and holds the user's JSON, exactly as given in the m
session.why: The session started on 2026-10-24. Its goal is to build the Agent OS page. The page is an artifact. It runs from its JSON state.

run.words: add on the screen fixed bottom right recoding button bottom one click recording, two click video recording, two times arrow up also start recoring and two arrow up and arrouw down at the same time video recording, when recording started show change this icon to stop and show timer somewhere in a header, also when recording start i am in a select mode and can select any block and view when selected show this element path
run.why: Andrei asked for a record button at the bottom right of the page. One click or two arrow-up keys record audio. Two clicks or arrow-up with arrow-down record video. While it records, the button shows stop, the header shows a timer, and Andrei can select a block or a view to see its element path. The run had to make this in version 35.

run make_state.py and all tests

steps.why: A test failed. The recorder function local.select has the same name as the timeline function. So a select in the recorder made a timeline block.
